---
name: Feature request
about: Something jackstream should do
labels: enhancement
---

**The moment** (what you are trying to do, as in "pick the release with French audio without
scrolling")

**What the addon should do** (a new filter, a change to how sources are sorted or shown…)

**Why the current settings do not cover it** (audio language, quality bounds, size limits,
blacklist, sorting)

Keep in mind what jackstream will not do: use a debrid service, need a second container or a
volume, store your keys on the server, or run without Jackett (see CONTRIBUTING.md,
Principles). Do not paste your addon URL, an API key or a tracker passkey.
